description: Press a push-button module (a sensor of type "button") for `seconds` and release it, like a person would. Held ≥ 0.8 s is a long press. The built-in program reacts: short press toggles the head's light tracking (happy face), long press stops everything (driving, autopilot, tracking; pauses the simulation). Returns the press event.

seconds.description: How long to hold it (default 0.2 s)

name: press_button
title: Press a button
